name: pokemon-companion
description: Nine animated companions, including seven Pokémon, Hello Kitty and Kuromi, help your AI control Windows through native APIs, keyboard input, and screenshots when needed.
long_description: Install, enable, and ask your AI to use Pokémon Companion. Includes Pikachu, Riolu, Lucario, Clodsire, Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle. Node, Electron, and native dependencies are included. Left-click the Pokémon to switch characters or exit. Talk is deferred and disabled; use your connected AI client for computer-control tasks.
